title: A way for a common event to play in battle?

posts.author: LupineDev
posts.body:
I'm making a game where the player is a wolf, and I got the idea that when the player encounters a herd of deer that they can just kill one deer, get meat, bones, and organ meat from a common event, and if they wish to, leave the rest of the herd alone. Wolves don't kill entire herds of deer in one hunt and I wanted the player to, let's say, kill a fawn, get its loot and leave the mother deer because they don't need to kill her too.
I got common events to play for the loot drops when an enemy reaches 0 HP, but it doesn't play when the last enemy dies because the victory thing overwrites it. Is there a plug in to help with this so that loot drops for the last enemy?

posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body:
If I'm understanding right, you might not need a plugin for this.
You want something like a "consume" skill during battle when the enemy reaches 10% or less life.  If consume is successful then the enemy dies and "fresh carcass" is added to your inventory. Similarly, if the enemy reaches 0, enemy leaves the item "fresh carcass."
You could use the information from this video to change it a bit to suit your needs:
RPG Maker MV Tutorial -how to catch enemies-
You might modify the consume skill to cause a status effect called fear which frightens enemies to run away.
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/monster-flee-from-battle.92489/

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
it can be done completely without any plugin, just with troop events.
1) create a troop event triggering on turn 0 that applies an immortal state to all enemies.
2) in each of the troop events on HP=0, add an "remove immortal state as the last command.
the result is that the enemy will only be killed after its kill processing troop event has been completed, because that is when the protection of the immortal state is removed.
